reason: Worked example at the strict perimeter boundary: the l=2pi case of the circle clause; admissible triangles of perimeter <2pi have a gap >=pi and lie in a complementary arc of length <pi where the metric is flat, so the comparison is an isometry and the CAT(1) inequality holds with equality; the equilateral triple has perimeter exactly 2pi and is not tested. Dependencies read and adequate. Level 10.
